title: World Substrate: actor information and independent concern
lead: Inspect the retained six-round autonomous pump run with separate Actor/Analyst views. The main Analyst inspector shows original words, interpretation and recorded result together. The original consent inversions remain visible; separately recorded native polarity/authority checks verify the later bounded correction. General semantic accuracy and scientific fidelity remain unproven.
what_you_do: Open the six-round recording, then Why things were refused in Analyst view and select Bo in round1. Compare his not-assenting words, the record-assent interpretation and the false-to-true recorded change. Use the separate correction recordings to inspect the deployed repair; no new run or plan approval is requested.
summary: I0 constrains both policy paths and continuation to declared actor inputs, with exact retained prompts and separate Analyst provenance.
I1 keeps reports and recipient exposure separate from technical truth, personal stance, recorded assent and institutional hold.
Legacy worlds retain their scripted/unrestricted compatibility mode. Passing checks establish specified contracts, not scientific actor fidelity or a preferred social outcome.
